ModMetaData.name: The Witcher's Path
ModMetaData.author: RedRaven
ModMetaData.description: Introduces Witcher mechanics to Rimworld Features: - Witcher trials with custom biotech genes - Monster mutagens obtained by butchering powerful beasts and monsters - Brew toxic witcher potions for temporary boosts - Steel & Silver weapons that deal additional damage based on target - Armor sets with set bonuses based on the schools of the wolf, cat, and bear - Quests to activate your witcher amulet in a Trial of the Mountain - Patches for Medieval Overhaul and Dark Ages: Beasts and Monsters
